race.comment: ASTON RENNES (8) drawn the outside box and could get a clear run. Was below best last time when 6th and beaten 6 lengths at this track (19.53). Has a strong winning record here at this journey including six wins. Can make amends. MINI EASY (1) goes very well this trip starting 14 times for five wins and three minors. Comes off a (17.12) win last time, scoring by 1.2 lengths in a Grade 5 over 300m at this track. Looks one of the chances. PERIODICAL (2) turned in a plain effort last time when sixth at this track over 300m behind Bicep (17.29) in a Grade 4/5. Has ability and is one of the better chances. JAZZ BAND (3) was out of the frame here most recently but can atone.
